svg.text: A CULTURAL PARK, SEEN FROM ABOVE
The same four marks become a place with height, purpose and connections.
A viewpoint becomes an imagined world through connected details.
Tower terraces suggest height; roofs carry fixtures; paths connect the garden and theatre.
Straight-down view: roof lights and equipment are visible, rather than facade windows.
Original marks stay dark green. One illustrative interpretation, drawn with Python Turtle.
